dmca.title: DMCA Takedown Process
dmca.subtitle: Follow these steps to submit a DMCA request via our Discord server.
dmca.step1Desc: First, you need to join the official UntitledCharts Discord server where our moderation team handles requests.
dmca.step2Desc: Navigate to the #tickets channel and create a new support ticket.
dmca.step3Desc: Once your ticket is open, fill out the details explaining your DMCA request. Please make sure to include:
dmca.step3Item1: Links to the copyrighted material on UntitledCharts.
dmca.step3Item2: Proof of original ownership or authorization to act on behalf of the owner.
dmca.step3Item3: A clear statement detailing the infringement.
dmca.falseClaims: False DMCA claims or any misuse of this process will result in a 1 week timeout.
dmca.policyIntro: UntitledCharts respects the intellectual property rights of others and expects its users to do the same. We respond to notices of alleged copyright infringement in accordance with the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA), 17 U.S.C. § 512, and other applicable laws.
dmca.policyNoticeBody: If you believe that content hosted on UntitledCharts infringes a copyright you own or are authorized to enforce, you may submit a written notice. To be effective, your notice must include the following:
dmca.policyNoticeItem1: A physical or electronic signature of the copyright owner or a person authorized to act on their behalf.
dmca.policyNoticeItem2: Identification of the copyrighted work claimed to have been infringed.
dmca.policyNoticeItem3: Identification of the material claimed to be infringing, including the URL of each chart on UntitledCharts.
dmca.policyNoticeItem4: Your contact information, including your name and an email address at which you can be reached.
dmca.policyNoticeItem5: A statement that you have a good-faith belief that use of the material is not authorized by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law.
dmca.policyNoticeItem6: A statement that the information in the notice is accurate and, under penalty of perjury, that you are the copyright owner or authorized to act on the owner's behalf.
dmca.policySubmitBody: Notices are handled through a private support ticket on the official UntitledCharts Discord server, where a member of staff will review your request and follow up with you directly.
dmca.policySubmitCardBody: Join the server, open a ticket in the support channel, and include every element listed above.
dmca.policyTicketStep1: Join the UntitledCharts Discord server using the button above.
dmca.policyTicketStep2: Open a ticket in the support channel and attach your notice.
dmca.policyReviewBody1: We review every complete notice. Where a notice is valid, the identified material is removed or access to it is disabled, and the uploader is notified of the action taken.
dmca.policyReviewBody2: Incomplete notices may be returned with a request for the missing information before any action is taken.
dmca.policyCounterBody: If your chart was removed and you believe this was the result of a mistake or misidentification, you may submit a counter-notification through the same support channel. It must include:
dmca.policyCounterItem2: Identification of the material that was removed and the location at which it appeared before removal.
dmca.policyCounterItem3: A statement, under penalty of perjury, that you have a good-faith belief the material was removed as a result of mistake or misidentification.
dmca.policyCounterItem4: Your name, address, and telephone number.
dmca.policyCounterItem5: A statement that you consent to the jurisdiction of the appropriate court and will accept service of process from the person who submitted the original notice.
dmca.policyCounterAfter: Upon receiving a valid counter-notification, we will forward it to the original complainant. The material may be restored in 10 to 14 business days unless the complainant notifies us that they have filed a court action seeking to restrain the alleged infringement.
dmca.policyRepeatBody: In appropriate circumstances, UntitledCharts may suspend or terminate the accounts of users who are found to be repeat infringers.
dmca.policyMisuseBody: Under 17 U.S.C. § 512(f), any person who knowingly and materially misrepresents that material is infringing, or that it was removed by mistake, may be liable for damages. Please make sure your claim is accurate before submitting it.
dmca.policyDisclaimer: This page describes how UntitledCharts handles copyright complaints. It is not legal advice. If you are unsure whether content infringes your rights, consult a qualified attorney.

uploadPolicy.title: Upload Policy
uploadPolicy.subtitle: Please read the following rules before uploading your charts.
uploadPolicy.rule1: No slurs, racism, politics, heavily inappropriate things, advertising, etc.
uploadPolicy.rule2: No super-low quality shitposts (we allow some shitposts)
uploadPolicy.rule3: No public Arcaea or Taiko no Tatsujin songs
uploadPolicy.rule4: Do not abuse our services for the sake of abusing them
uploadPolicy.rule5: No official charts with minor modifications (All Flicks or All Traces are allowed occasionally only)
uploadPolicy.rule8: Your metadata must be correct (including jackets)
uploadPolicy.relaxedNote: Rules 2, 3, 5, 7, and 8 can be ignored if Unlisted.
uploadPolicy.fileSizeDesc: If your charts are larger than the upload limit, you can request support to help! We don't want to limit actual charts; so we will help you upload it!
uploadPolicy.shitpostWarning: Shitposts are not allowed for this exception. Please reconsider your life choices if you're uploading shitposts larger than the file limits.
uploadPolicy.fileTypesNote: Note: Extreme extended features can only be found in LevelData! You can open .usc in the editor to continue working.
